review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-03 delegated author, review fix round); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-03 part A1a, review fix round: migration 0002 is finished before it is first applied (comments on the e-mail data it holds, indexes on every referencing column, a complete e-mail step-up verifier, a 1023-byte passkey credential ID, the registration label of a flow, outcomes 1 and 2 only, per-column e-mail material); the store reports a COMMIT without a definite answer as an unknown outcome that is never retried; RefreshSession reads its reply's device in the rotating transaction; a past bootstrap expiry starts the center; the bootstrap digest is the SHA-256 of the token text; listed sessions honour their refresh expiry; a spent refresh token is audited once; wrong e-mail codes reserve their address's failure atomically; anonymous failures are audited once per client prefix; a verified proof gets its attempt back after a store failure; cursor instants, time zones and the passkey counter follow their contract and library rules; the center sends every reply its budget admits and logs a not_activated reply with its correlation id. The Worker keys both edge rate limits by client network (an IPv6 client by its /64, a generated length) and dates its rate_limited reply from a generated template; the acceptance environment passes an opt-in ceiling on anonymous flows. No module, package, base image, toolchain or legal file changes.
